description: Authorization scopes and role collections for the NovaTech Leave Management application

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Employee
scopes.description: Employee: submit, view and cancel own leave requests

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Manager
scopes.description: Manager: view and approve/reject direct reports' leave requests

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.HRAdmin
scopes.description: HR Admin: full read/write across all leave data, manage master data

role-collections.name: LeaveEmployee
role-collections.description: CRUD on own leave requests only

role-collections.name: LeaveHRAdmin
role-collections.description: Full read/write across all data, manage master data
